# Self Assessor repository instructions for GitHub Copilot

This repository **supplies** the Software Delivery Assessment skill; it is **not** the repository to assess unless the user explicitly requests that.

When a user says `Start https://github.com/feamar/self-assessor/`, read [START.md](../START.md) and follow its remote-bootstrap workflow. Load the complete `.github/skills/software-delivery-assessment/SKILL.md` and relevant references; do not improvise the assessment from the README. Assess the **developer's intended product/service workspace**, not this repository.

Only use read-only inspection until separately authorized for actions such as executing tests, accessing external systems or writing files. Always produce separate perspectives and evidence-grounded judgments.
